notes.title: Lloyd the Monkey Comes to France!
notes.notes: [p]Thanks everyone for downloading [b][i]Lloyd the Monkey: Remastered[/i][/b]. We're thrilled that the first installment of the trilogy is now accessible to so many players. To make the launch even better, we're excited to announce that we have added a French localization penned by freelance translator [b]Aurélien Folley[/b].[/p][p]The French version is accessible from the title screen, just like the Japanese version. [b][i]Amusez-vous bien ![/i][/b][/p]
